verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-facing banking API platform with a dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product assistant that can take delegated tasks. The llms.txt file and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks for external AI tools, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
